temporal_state_chain.observed: At the funeral, Sara sees Shirley's somber demeanor and hears her say the loss has been tough and that she wonders if more could have been done.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara knows Shirley as a colleague and may not yet know how deeply the patient's death has affected her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara's observations and Shirley's words confirm that Shirley cared deeply and is grieving.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is deeply affected by the patient's death, is struggling to let go, and may need reassurance and support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Comfort Shirley and remind her that they provided good care and brought moments of joy to the patient.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During a coffee break, Sara learns that Shirley feels responsible for the patient's outcome and wonders whether pushing for a different approach could have helped.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving the patient's death and having difficulty letting go.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns that Shirley is also carrying guilt and self-blame about the treatment decisions.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is grieving and feels personally responsible for the outcome; she needs reassurance that the decisions were sound and that she should not carry the burden alone.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Alleviate Shirley's sense of responsibility and reassure her that they made the best decisions with the information available.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley has continued to be reserved and minimally expressive; when confronted, Shirley says she does not want to seem unprofessional or weak.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley is grieving, feels responsible, and may be withdrawing emotionally.

temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is suppressing her emotional distress and needs a safe, nonjudgmental space to express it; expressing emotions is not a sign of weakness.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Encourage Shirley to open up and reassure her that showing emotion among friends is healthy and acceptable.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara apologizes for possibly coming on too strong; Shirley says it was a bit much but acknowledges Sara meant well and appreciates the apology.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara worries her previous confrontation may have been too harsh and could have strained their friendship, though she still wants to support Shirley.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara learns that Shirley felt she was a bit much but also understands her intent and values the apology and continued conversation.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is receptive to Sara's apology and still values their talks; the friendship can continue and Sara can remain supportive.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Mend the friendship, remain available for Shirley, and continue talking in whatever way Shirley needs.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Sara notices Shirley seems to be doing better; Shirley confirms she feels better because of their talks and Sara's support, and she agrees to spend time together on the weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Sara believes Shirley has been struggling but is gradually improving, and that their talks have been helpful.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; Sara's observation is confirmed by Shirley's report of improvement and her willingness to spend more time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Shirley is recovering and values Sara's support; she is open to deepening their friendship and spending time together outside work.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue supporting Shirley and plan to spend time together outside of work, such as on the weekend.
